title: DNA Extraction Protocol for Cryptosporidium spp. in Stool Samples
author: Asar Khan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tb5eiq6

steps.title: Prepare stool-bead mixture
steps.instruction: Place 1 g stool in a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 500 mg (0.5 g) glass beads and 1 mL SLX‑buffer; vortex at maximum speed for 5 min. Add 100 µL DS‑buffer, vortex 3 min, then incubate at 70 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: First centrifugation and P2 treatment
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 5,000 × g for 3 min at room temperature; transfer 800 µL supernatant to a new tube. Add 270 µL P2‑buffer, vortex thoroughly, incubate on ice for 5 min. Centrifuge again at 14,000 × g for 3 min and transfer all supernatant to a fresh 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Elution buffer and HTR addition
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL EB (Elution Buffer), pulse‑vortex, and incubate at 70 °C for 10–20 min to dissolve the DNA pellet. Add 100 µL HTR reagent, vortex 10 s, incubate at room temperature for 2 min. Centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 2 min and transfer the supernatant to a clean 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL (0.7 × sample volume) isopropanol, invert the tube 20–30 times to mix, then centrifuge at 14,000 × g for 10 min. Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the DNA pellet, and invert tubes on a paper towel for 1 min to drain residual liquid.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL Proteinase‑K to each 1.5 mL tube, vortex thoroughly, and incubate at 37 °C for 10 min. Add XP1‑buffer equal to the tube volume (≈1.5 mL) and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Spin‑column binding
steps.instruction: Insert a spin column into a 2 mL collection tube, transfer 600 µL of the sample onto the column, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min and discard the flow‑through. Add 300 µL XP1‑buffer, centrifuge 10,000 × g for 1 min, discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Place the column into a new 2 mL collection tube, add 700 µL SPW wash buffer, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 1 min and discard flow‑through. Repeat the 700 µL SPW wash step once more and discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column and elute
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 14,000 × g for 2 min to remove ethanol, then transfer the column to a clean 2 mL tube. Add 60 µL Elution Buffer directly onto the membrane centre, incubate at 70 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Second elution and storage
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 14,000 × g for 1 min to elute DNA; repeat with a second 60 µL of Elution Buffer. Discard the column and store the eluted DNA at –20 °C until amplification.
